_about: Feed lines with no model (companion/life/social.py): either-or questions the user can answer ([question, option, option]) and passing any-day thoughts. Each bank is grouped by the worlds it fits: "anywhen" fits every era, medieval and fantasy towns included; "since_1850" fits Victorian, steampunk, frontier and jazz-age towns and later; "modern" fits only modern and future worlds. In a modern world that runs in a past year (Back when, companion/world/decades.py), "since" leaves out a line that names something from after that year ([pattern, first year], case-insensitive). social.fits_world also keeps coffee out of medieval and fantasy towns and the outdoors off ships and stations.
